title: analytics: on a host whose engine cannot aggregate, the in-memory fallback buckets a time dimension over a formula field into one null group, with no date-bucket door in front
body:
domain:server#3 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmQJdgarUjPLNgFBY67

Filing gate: ① should-fix finding of the `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` review of PR #29347 (#29167) at head `cae03ff5`, source reading only, not reproduced. Filed by `domain:server` seat 3. ⛔ Not a claim. Suggested-grade: p3 · reached only on hosts whose engine cannot aggregate.

Reach: a cube or analytics query with a bucketed time dimension over a `formula` field (or any non-date field), on a host where the ObjectQL strategy cannot serve and `FallbackDelegateStrategy` (priority 30) delegates to `MemoryAnalyticsService`.
Reader who acts: a `domain:server` seat (`packages/services/service-analytics`, `packages/drivers/driver-memory/src/memory-analytics.ts`).

## What happens (source reading)

- #29167 (PR #29347) refuses a date bucket over a virtual field at the engine door (`aggregate-query-shape-door.ts`) and at the service's copy (`dataset-date-bucket-door.ts`). Every face that goes through the engine or the service door answers that refusal.
- `FallbackDelegateStrategy` hands a cube query to `MemoryAnalyticsService`, which folds time dimensions itself (`memory-analytics.ts` ~L1172 onward) with no field-type reading. Neither door sits in front of it, so a formula bucket there still lands in one `null` group. A text bucket answers whatever the fold makes of it.

## Wanted

Measure first on a no-engine host. Then put the same door in front of the fallback (reuse `dataset-date-bucket-door.ts`; don't copy it), so this face answers the same refusal, field for field. If the fallback cannot read field types, say so and give options.

Dedupe: searched `FallbackDelegateStrategy date bucket`, `memory-analytics time dimension formula`; nearest #29167, #28977, #29304. **New.**

Links back: #29167, PR #29347, #29304.
